abstract: OBJECTIVE: To compare the clinical outcome of women with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) treated with the conventional EMA/CO (etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin-D, cyclophosphamide, vincristine) with those treated with the modified EM/CO regimen. METHODS: Brazilian multicenter retrospective cohort study evaluated medical records of women diagnosed with GTN who were treated with the standard EMA/CO or with the modified regimen in which actinomycin-D was suppressed (EM/CO). The primary outcome was the occurrence of remission following chemotherapy treatment. RESULTS: Remission rate with EMA/CO was 85.3%, with 14.7% of women showing chemoresistance, while with EM/CO, the remission rate was 72.7%, with 27.3% of women chemoresistance, without statistical difference between the groups. A total of 142 women were analyzed, of whom 109 were treated with EMA/CO and 33 received EM/CO. Women who used the EM/CO had higher prevalence of invasive mole (51.5% vs. 14.7%, p<0.0001), lower prevalence of choriocarcinoma (9.1% vs. 26.6%, p=0.035), and lower prevalence of metastases (33.3% vs. 61.5%, p=0.004) compared to women who received the EMA/CO. Women with risk score ≥ 7 had higher prevalence of recurrence (61.5% vs 10.0%, p=0.005) and chemoresistance using the EM/CO (53.8% vs 10.0%, p=0.013) compared to women with score ≤ 6. The pre-treatment serum hCG levels was a moderately significant predictor (AUC: 0.77, 95%CI 0.66-0.88, p<0.0001) for identifying chemoresistance. The number of EM/CO cycles was a strong significant predictor (AUC: 0.81, 95%CI 0.66-0.96, p<0.0001) for identifying toxicity to chemotherapy. CONCLUSION: EM/CO had higher prevalence of need for second-line treatment, and chemoresistance.
abstract_ja: 目的：従来のEMA/CO療法と、アクチノマイシンDを省いた修正レジメンであるEM/CO療法で治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）患者の臨床転帰を比較すること。方法：標準的なEMA/CO療法または修正EM/CO療法で治療されたGTN患者の診療録を評価した、ブラジルの多施設後方視的コホート研究。主要評価項目は化学療法後の寛解の発生。結果：EMA/CO群の寛解率は85.3%、化学抵抗性は14.7%であった。EM/CO群の寛解率は72.7%、化学抵抗性は27.3%であった。両群間に統計的有意差はなかった。計142例を解析し、109例がEMA/COで、33例がEM/COで治療された。EM/CO群では侵入奇胎の頻度が高く（51.5%対14.7%、p<0.0001）、絨毛癌（9.1%対26.6%、p=0.035）と転移（33.3%対61.5%、p=0.004）の頻度は低かった。リスクスコアが7以上の女性は、6以下の女性と比べ、再発（61.5%対10.0%、p=0.005）およびEM/CO療法での化学抵抗性（53.8%対10.0%、p=0.013）の頻度が高かった。治療前の血清hCG値は化学抵抗性を識別する中等度の有意な予測因子であった（AUC 0.77、95%CI 0.66-0.88、p<0.0001）。EM/CO療法のサイクル数は、化学療法の毒性を識別する強い有意な予測因子であった（AUC 0.81、95%CI 0.66-0.96、p<0.0001）。結論：EM/COは二次治療を必要とする頻度と化学抵抗性が高かった。
